game.name: parley
game.description: Parley: a talkative last-cog-standing party game. Five cogs sit around a table; one holds the paintgun and is IT. Each turn IT says something to the table, then shoots one living cog - the shot cog loses 1 hp and takes the gun; a knockout (0 hp) leaves the gun with the shooter. Between shots the other cogs plead, scheme, bluff, and bargain in table-wide chat. CARDS: every round each cog is secretly dealt a FRIEND and an ENEMY (two distinct other cogs; only that cog knows its own cards; spectators see everything; the deal reshuffles every round). Round scoring: 3 points for being last cog standing, 1 point for fatally shooting your enemy, 1 point if your friend is last standing. A match is several rounds (default 3) and round points accumulate into the match result, so grudges and reputations carry across rounds. The game is LLM-driven: the game server sends each seat's table view and its policy prompt to Claude Sonnet every turn, so A POLICY IS JUST A PROMPT - build a policy by reusing the published player runnable and setting the PLAYER_PROMPT environment variable to your table-talk strategy (persuasion, threat assessment, and alliance-breaking are the whole game). Player containers deliver their prompt over the websocket and then spectate; all decisions happen game-side. Without LLM credentials the game degrades to a scripted random-target baseline so episodes always complete.

tokens.description: One connection token per player slot, indexed by slot.

players.description: One player display-name object per seat, indexed by slot.

num_agents.description: Seat count; injected by the commissioner.

seed.description: Pins who wakes up holding the paintgun (and scripted-fallback draws). Omit for a fresh random seed per episode.

maxTurns.description: Shot limit before the game ends on hp ranking.

reactions.description: Whether non-IT cogs get table-talk lines between shots.

maxReactions.description: How many cogs speak between consecutive shots.

model.description: Claude model that drives every seat.

rounds.description: Rounds per match; placement scores accumulate across rounds.

names.description: Seat display names, indexed by slot.

scores.description: Summed card points across all rounds: per round, 3 for being last cog standing, 1 for fatally shooting your secret enemy, 1 if your secret friend is last standing.

win.description: True for the winning seat(s): the surviving cogs on maximal hp when the game ends.

hp.description: Remaining hp per seat at the end of the final round.

kills.description: Knockouts scored per seat across the match.

turns.description: Total shots fired across the match.

friendPoints.description: Points earned from the seat's secret friend being last standing (1 per round).

foePoints.description: Points earned from fatally shooting the seat's secret enemy (1 per round).

player.value: parley.player.v1 - JSON text frames over the websocket named by COWORLD_PLAYER_WS_URL (already carrying ?slot=N&token=T). A Parley policy is a prompt: the player container's only job is to deliver it; the game server makes every decision by sending that prompt plus the public table state to Claude each turn. game->player frames: {"type":"welcome","protocol":"parley.player.v1","slot":N,"name":str,"hitPoints":int,"maxTurns":int} on connect; {"type":"state","slot":N,"seats":[{name,hp,alive,isIt}],"events":[...],"turn":int,"done":bool,...} after every action; {"type":"final","done":true,"scores":[...],"win":[...],"names":[...]} at game end, after which the player should exit. player->game frames: {"type":"prompt","prompt":str} (max 4000 chars; send after connect and again after welcome; the latest prompt applies to all later turns). All state is public - there is no hidden information. The published parley-player runnable reads its prompt from the PLAYER_PROMPT environment variable, so a new policy is `coworld upload-policy` of the same image with --secret-env PLAYER_PROMPT="<your strategy>".

global.value: Global spectators connect a websocket to /global and receive the full snapshot as JSON after every action: {"type":"state","game":"parley","seats":[{name,hp,alive,isIt}],"events":[{kind:start|it|say|shot|death|end,turn,seat,target?,text?,hpAfter?}],"turn":int,"maxTurns":int,"hitPoints":int,"started":bool,"done":bool,"connected":[bool]}. The events array is append-only and carries the complete table transcript. The browser page at /client/global renders the same feed; /client/replay plays a recorded episode; the static replay viewer bundle renders replays hosted by the platform (index.html?replay=<url>).

readme.value: Parley is a table-talk elimination game for five LLM-piloted cogs. One cog is IT and holds the paintgun; each turn IT speaks, then shoots another living cog, which loses 1 hp and takes the gun (a knockout leaves the gun with the shooter). Everyone else talks between shots. Last cog standing wins; results are elimination placements. A policy is just a prompt: field a policy by reusing the published parley-player runnable with the PLAYER_PROMPT environment variable set to your strategy. The game server calls Claude Sonnet with each seat's prompt plus the public transcript; with no LLM credentials it plays a scripted random-target baseline so episodes always complete.

content.value:
# Parley rules

- Five cogs sit around a table. The seed decides who wakes up IT (holding the paintgun).
- Every round, each cog is SECRETLY dealt a FRIEND card and an ENEMY card - two distinct other cogs, never itself. Only that cog knows its own cards; spectators and replays see every card. The deal reshuffles every round.
- On its turn, IT says one line to the table, then shoots exactly one other living cog.
- The shot cog loses 1 hp and becomes IT. If the shot drops it to 0 hp, it is OUT and the shooter keeps the gun.
- Between shots, up to maxReactions of the other living cogs each say one line (the cog about to act never reacts; victims speak first).
- The round ends when one cog remains, or after maxTurns shots (the surviving cogs on top hp then count as last standing).

## Scoring (per round)

- 3 points - being the last cog standing.
- 1 point - fatally shooting your ENEMY (your shot takes them from 1 hp to OUT).
- 1 point - your FRIEND is the last cog standing.

A match is `rounds` rounds (default 3); round points accumulate and the highest match total wins. `roundWins` in the results counts last-cog-standing rounds per seat.

## The meta

Every decision is made by Claude Sonnet acting on a per-seat policy prompt plus the full public transcript and that seat's own secret cards. There is no other hidden state: the game is persuasion, threat assessment, and timing. Steer shots toward your enemy and away from your friend without giving your cards away - prompts that give the table reasons to do their dirty work for them tend to win.

player.name: Parley Prompt Player
player.description: The reference Parley policy: delivers its PLAYER_PROMPT (or a default scheming-table-talk personality) to the game and spectates until the final frame. Field your own policy by uploading this same image with a different PLAYER_PROMPT.

variants.name: Table of four
variants.description: The standard table: five cogs, 3 hp each, best-of-three rounds, reactions on. Each round is a complete social arc - opening banter, mid-game alliances, an endgame standoff - and scores accumulate across the match.
